notes: Counts are null until a senior signs them. Do not reuse 5,594 or mzr marker counts as paired alignment counts, and do not guess a Portuguese edition or total. The mzr package alone provides one side; the Portuguese package's presence in the repository authorizes its processing (ADR-0025), while versification compatibility is a processing precondition, not a licence gate. Count meanings, used identically on memory and PostgreSQL: common_groups is every Stage 4 group (structural and partial-coverage candidate groups) produced by one canonical alignment run over the full pair; unmatched_source and unmatched_target are ALL-UNIT unmatched entries of that run's report, i.e. verse locators without a counterpart plus every non-verse unit (headings, titles, notes, XXF front matter) reported with a fixed reason; book_inventory maps each declared book code to [source, target] verse-piece counts, keeping verse-free books as [0, 0].
